# Cyclopts

> Cyclopts is a Python library for building CLIs from type-hinted functions. The CLI is derived from the function signature, type hints, and docstring; `Parameter(...)` is only needed to change a specific behavior. Help text should come from docstrings, not `Parameter(help=...)`. Add short flags with `Parameter(alias="-x")`, not `Parameter(name=[...])`.

Full concatenated documentation: https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/llms-full.txt

A skill file for coding assistants ships with the package: `cyclopts skill install` (Claude Code) or `cyclopts skill show`.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started.html): minimal app, commands, docstring help
- [Commands](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/commands.html): `@app.command`, `@app.default`, sub-apps
- [Parameters](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/parameters.html): naming, `alias`, positional vs keyword, booleans
- [Rules](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rules.html): how each type hint is parsed
- [API](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html): every `App` and `Parameter` attribute

## Common tasks

- [Parameter Validators](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/parameter_validators.html): `validators.Number`, `validators.Path`, custom validators and converters
- [Groups](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/groups.html): help panels and mutually-exclusive options
- [User Classes](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/user_classes.html): dataclass/attrs/pydantic parameters
- [Config Files](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/config_file.html): TOML/JSON/YAML/env-var defaults
- [Meta App](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/meta_app.html): cross-cutting options like `--verbose`
- [Help](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/help.html): docstring formats, markdown/rst/rich
- [Unit Testing](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cookbook/unit_testing.html)
- [Shell Completion](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/shell_completion.html)

## Migrating

- [Migrating From Typer](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/migration/typer.html): Typer idiom to Cyclopts idiom table
- [Typer Comparison](https://cyclopts.readthedocs.io/en/latest/vs_typer/README.html)
